## Results: 5 Distinct Blob-Like Objects

The dataset contains **5 disconnected blobs**, identified by thresholding the `Intensity` field at 1.0 and running connected-component analysis. Their voxel-space centers are:

| Blob | Voxel Center (x, y, z) | Size (points) | Bounding Box |
|------|------------------------|---------------|--------------|
| 1 | **(16, 41, 13)** | 365 | x[12–20], y[37–45], z[9–17] |
| 2 | **(43, 23, 21)** | 619 | x[38–48], y[18–28], z[16–26] |
| 3 | **(15, 49, 25)** | 619 | x[10–20], y[44–54], z[20–30] |
| 4 | **(36, 47, 42)** | 365 | x[32–40], y[43–51], z[38–46] |
| 5 | **(47, 36, 55)** | 329 | x[43–51], y[32–40], z[51–59] |

**Key observations:**
- Blobs 2 and 3 are the largest (619 points each), while Blob 5 is the smallest (329 points).
- The blobs are well-separated in 3D space with no overlap in their bounding boxes, confirming they are cleanly disconnected.
- All centers are reported as integer voxel coordinates (the centroids are exactly at integer positions, indicating symmetric blob shapes).
